definitions.explanation: The number six. A straightforward number in Japanese with consistent pronunciation in most contexts.

examples.english: I wake up at six o'clock.

examples.japanese: ⟦ビール→びーる：01015_biiru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{六|ろっ}⟦{本|ぽん}→ほん：00688_hon⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.notes: Note: ろく becomes ろっ before ほん→ぽん

examples.japanese: ⟦{六|ろく}{月|がつ}→ろくがつ：00662_rokugatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→つゆ：02232_tsuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→きせつ：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦{友達|ともだち}→ともだち：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{六|ろく}⟦{人|にん}→にん：00658_nin⟧⟦{来|き}た→くる：00254_kuru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{椅子|いす}→いす：00706_isu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りませんでした→たりる：01209_tariru⟧。
examples.english: Six friends came, so we didn't have enough chairs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{六|ろく}{月|がつ}→ろくがつ：00662_rokugatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→あめ：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→おおい：01127_ooi⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。⟦{毎日|まいにち}→まいにち：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{傘|かさ}→かさ：00639_kasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→もつ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{出|で}かけなければなりません→でかける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: There's a lot of rain in June. I have to go out with an umbrella every day.

notes:
{六|ろく} is the number six. The native Japanese counting word is {六|むっ}つ (muttsu).

COUNTING PATTERNS:
When combined with counters starting with h-sounds, ろく often becomes ろっ:
- {六|ろっ}{本|ぽん} (roppon): six long objects
- {六|ろっ}{百|ぴゃく} (roppyaku): 600
- {六|ろっ}{匹|ぴき} (roppiki): six animals

NO CHANGE:
- {六|ろく}{時|じ} (rokuji): six o'clock
- {六|ろく}{人|にん} (rokunin): six people
- ⟦{六|ろく}{月|がつ}→ろくがつ：00662_rokugatsu⟧ (rokugatsu): June

CULTURAL NOTE:
Six is generally considered a lucky number in Japan.
